---
title: "Genie Info 2026"
---

You will build an image processing tool in C, working as a team. Features are delivered incrementally, managed with GitHub issues, and evaluated automatically every day.

## Three spaces, one project

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    CL["🎓 GitHub Classroom<br>Register your team"] -->|"creates"| GH["☁️ GitHub Repository<br>Shared code · Issues · CI"]
    LM["💻 Local Machine<br>VS Code · gcc · CMake"] <-->|"git push / pull"| GH
```

Every line you write lives locally until you push it. GitHub Actions compile and test what is on `main` every day — that is what gets graded.

> New? Start with [The Project Ecosystem](Getting-Started/Ecosystem.qmd) to understand what connects what.

## Onboarding — follow in order

Do not skip ahead. Each step depends on the previous one.

1. [The Project Ecosystem](Getting-Started/Ecosystem.qmd) — understand the three spaces and the overall flow
2. [Setup](Getting-Started/Setup.qmd) — register team, clone, install tools, validate, activate workflows, import issues
3. [First Steps](Getting-Started/First-Steps.qmd) — learn the dev loop, then start Milestone 1 together

## Course goals

- Organize a software project with milestones and issues
- Work as a team with Git and GitHub Classroom
- Build and validate a C project with VS Code and CMake
- Implement image processing features incrementally
- Prepare for individual coding in the final exam
